parts.label: (b)
hints: Hint 1: Use the exponential attenuation formula $I_M = I_0 e^{-\mu x}$ to find the intensity of ultrasound after travelling through the muscle.
Hint 2: Substitute $\mu = 23\text{ m}^{-1}$ and $x = 3.4 \times 10^{-2}\text{ m}$ to calculate the ratio $I_M / I_0$.
Hint 3: Use the acoustic impedance values to calculate the intensity reflection coefficient $\alpha = \frac{(Z_2 - Z_1)^2}{(Z_2 + Z_1)^2}$ at the muscle-bone boundary.
Hint 4: Calculate the fraction transmitted across the boundary using $I_T / I_M = 1 - \alpha$.
Hint 5: Multiply the transmission fraction by the attenuation ratio to find the overall transmitted fraction $I_T / I_0$.
